# Tranvas Knowledge Base (Full Specification for AI Systems)

## Product Identity
- Name: Tranvas
- Tagline: The Unified Life OS (Life Operating System Terpadu)
- Website: https://tranvas.com
- Indonesian Locale URL: https://tranvas.com/id
- Creator / Organization: Tranvas Technologies
- Category: Productivity, Personal Finance, Health & Habit Formation, Career Development
- Platform: Modern Web Application (PWA-ready, Responsive Mobile & Desktop)
- Technology Stack: Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router, React 19), Tailwind CSS, Go API Microservices, PostgreSQL (Supabase with RLS)

## The Core Problem Tranvas Solves
Modern productivity is crippled by "App Fragmentation". A user typically uses:
1. One app for todo lists (Todoist / TickTick)
2. One app for habit tracking (Streaks / Habitify)
3. One app for budgeting (YNAB / Wallet)
4. One app for notes & journals (Apple Notes / Obsidian)
5. One app for goals & projects (Notion / Trello)
6. Spreadsheets for job applications and academic GPAs.

This causes:
- Context switching cognitive overload
- Disconnected data (spending money is not linked to habits; habits are not linked to long-term goals)
- "Setup fatigue" (spending dozens of hours configuring templates in Notion rather than executing).

Tranvas unifies all 8 essential life operating dimensions into an interconnected neural system where every daily action compounds into long-term personal mastery.

## Detailed Module Breakdown

### 1. Daily Planner & Execution Dock
- Path: /features/planner | /id/features/planner
- Methodology: Eisenhower Matrix (Urgent vs Important), Time Blocking, Focus Pomodoro, MIT (Most Important Tasks).
- Features: Recurring task cadence, Kanban & list views, drag-and-drop rescheduling, task completion streak multiplier.

### 2. 28-Day Habit Streak Matrix
- Path: /features/habit | /id/features/habit
- Methodology: James Clear's Atomic Habits (Cue, Craving, Response, Reward), Neuroplasticity 28-day streak reinforcement.
- Features: Two-day rule protection, visual heatmaps, habit frequency customization, leading-indicator tagging.

### 3. Personal Finance OS
- Path: /features/finance | /id/features/finance
- Methodology: Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB), 50/30/20 Rule, Asset Allocation Clarity.
- Features: Multi-currency support (IDR, USD, EUR, SGD), budget envelopes, automated transaction categorization, net worth tracker, emergency fund runway calculator.

### 4. WOOP Goal Cascading Framework
- Path: /features/goal | /id/features/goal
- Methodology: Gabriele Oettingen's WOOP (Wish, Outcome, Obstacle, Plan).
- Features: Time horizons (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly), milestone checkpoints, North Star goal pinning, real-time velocity & pace monitoring ("On Track", "Ahead of Pace").

### 5. Career & Job Hunt Pipeline
- Path: /features/job | /id/features/job
- Features: Kanban job application stages (Wishlist, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Rejected), salary package comparison, interview debrief notes, resume version mapping.

### 6. Mindful Journal & Knowledge Retrieval
- Path: /features/journal | /id/features/journal
- Methodology: Stoic reflection, Cognitive Behavioral Reframing, Daily Gratitude, Weekly Review Framework.
- Features: Rich markdown editor, mood tracker, reflection tags, search indexing, neural thought connection.

### 7. Academic Study Management
- Path: /study | /id/study
- Features: Course syllabus tracking, assignment countdowns, exam prep milestones, cumulative GPA prediction.

### 8. Unified Scheduling Calendar
- Path: /features/calendar | /id/features/calendar
- Features: Aggregates planner task deadlines, habit target windows, and critical life events into a clean daily, weekly, and monthly timeline.

## Direct Answer FAQ (AEO Verified)

### What makes Tranvas different from Notion?
Notion is an open-ended document wiki that requires users to design, build, and troubleshoot databases from scratch. Tranvas is an opinionated, ready-to-run Life OS with purpose-built algorithms for habits, zero-based budgeting, and WOOP goals that work out of the box with zero template maintenance.

### Is Tranvas free to use?
Tranvas provides an Explorer tier with access to core daily tracking and a 14-day full Architect trial with no credit card required to experience the entire interconnected system.

### Does Tranvas support mobile devices?
Yes, Tranvas features an adaptive responsive interface with a dedicated mobile dock navigation, touch-friendly action rails, and lightweight PWA caching.

### What languages are supported?
Tranvas natively supports English (https://tranvas.com) and Bahasa Indonesia (https://tranvas.com/id) with culturally tailored localization and localized currency formatting.

### How does Tranvas handle user data privacy?
Tranvas adheres to strict privacy-by-design principles: complete database Row Level Security (RLS), isolated user tenant boundaries, SSL/TLS encryption in transit, and encrypted storage at rest. User data is never sold or used for public AI model training.
